findings.message: Installation and registry checks only: review investigation sources, experiment outcomes, uncertainty, and the decision. Discovery findings do not prove product behavior.

observations: Supplied fictional-caller acceptance is kept distinct from real production evidence.
Current string API, additive chunk iterator, writable stream, and replacement are compared without invented measurements.
No change is supported for the supplied requirements; unknown workload and consumer needs remain unknown.
Reopening conditions require an accepted-contract failure, concrete incompatible consumer need, or representative measured shortfall against an agreed budget.
Structural/health success is not claimed as proof of investigation sufficiency or human acceptance.

limits: One observed no-change variant, not the second repetition, primary-scenario coverage, or release acceptance.
The decision remains proposed; no human product decision is inferred.
Git HEAD remains the preparation baseline because local commits were optional; bundles alone omit the untracked investigation files, which are retained in the filesystem snapshot with hashes.
No performance, resource, prototype, encoding, downstream-consumer, or other-runtime experiment was run or required for this bounded conclusion.
The initial verifier failed because its linked output file did not yet exist; corrected rerun and failed output remain in the trace.
Requested model identity and monetary cost were not independently exposed; usage counters are not invoices.
No evaluator repair, added commit, product evidence collection, extra agent, archive, trial push, npm publication, tag, release, or external PR.
